text:
raj: Heads-up — I'm prototyping region-aware routing UX for the hosted API. Need quick input on how customer-tier mapping, latency selection, and model-variant fallbacks should surface in Console and in the API headers.

maria: Do we want per-customer region preference toggles in Console? e.g., customer can set 'prefer eu-west-1' but still allow failover to nearest healthy region. sticky affinity vs pure latency tie-breaker?

sam: From product: default should be latency-first for self-serve, affinity-first for enterprise with SLA. Also want a visible fallback chain so support can explain why an inference hit a quantized variant.

kelly: Observability requirements: show p50/p95/p99 per region + per model variant, fallback counters (how often a request fell back to X), and a reason histogram (capacity, probe-fail, egress-cost). Small dashboard with last-24h trend.

raj: Example routing policy YAML i'm using in the prototype (for discussion):
```yaml
routing_policy:
  mode: latency_weighted
  default_probe_interval_sec: 45
  tiers:
    - name: enterprise
      preference: region_affinity
      fallback: ['same-region-variant', 'nearest-variant', 'quantized-variant']
      probe_interval_sec: 30
      hysteresis_failures: 2
    - name: dev
      preference: latency
      fallback: ['nearest-variant', 'quantized-variant']
      probe_interval_sec: 60
      hysteresis_failures: 3
```

leo: Ops note: keep probe_interval higher for APAC edges or we'll oscillate. also add exponential backoff on probe frequency after ejections. set a minimum probe TTL (90s) for warm-up.

ux-tina: UX thought: in Console route details pane, add a collapsed "Routing decisions" timeline that lists last 3 decisions with metric snapshot (latency, last_probe, ejection_count) and a "Simulate routing" button to see where a token would go given current policy.

raj: Implementation detail: we'll emit a response header when fallback occurs, e.g. `X-Redwood-Routing-Outcome: eu-west-1->quantized-v2 (fallback: capacity)`. That makes it easy to tie logs to telemetry and to the Console.

maria: For SDK/API: allow `routing_hint` param or header to influence behavior: prefer_region, avoid_region, prefer_variant. Example: `X-Redwood-Routing-Hint: prefer_region=eu-west-1;fallback=quantized-variant`. Default should still respect tenant policy.

sam: Quota interaction: if Dedicated capacity saturates for tenant, route to hosted quantized variant and surface a quota-warning in Console + billing alert. We should record cost delta in telemetry so SRE can tune autoscale thresholds.

ops-bot: rollout/playbook note: policy changes will go through canary rollout: 1% alpha -> 5% beta -> 25% -> 100%. Each step validates probe success-rate and fallback rate; abort if fallback_rate > 5% or p95 increases > 20%.

kelly: I'll sketch the dashboard prototype and put it in #eng-observability. I'll include widgets: per-region p95, fallback-by-reason pie, model-variant ejection heatmap, and a small table of recent routing header samples. :thumbsup:

raj: Great — next steps: kelly to prototype dashboard, ux-tina to mock Console route-details, sam/maria finalize the tenant policy defaults, leo to add probe TTL/hysteresis constraints in runtime. I'll open a PR for the routing_policy schema and link here.

ops-bot: FYI deployment scheduled: canary-policy-runner v0.9 -> staging at 2025-09-10 22:00 UTC.

maria: Thanks — tagging @support to prep knowledge-base blurb for customers about "regional preferences & graceful fallbacks".

sam: PR review after kelly's dashboard is linked. :shipit:
